title: Unit tests in one process wait on SQLite's process-wide locks; decide how the bundled SQLite is compiled
outcome: A measured decision on the bundled SQLite's compile flags, so that test threads beyond eight speed the gate up instead of slowing it down, without changing what the shipped binary guarantees.
acceptance: A decision on compiling the bundled SQLite with SQLITE_DEFAULT_MEMSTATUS=0 is recorded with its measurements and with what the shipped binary loses (sqlite3_status memory counters, soft heap limit)
If flags change, the lib test binary's wall time at 24 threads is lower than at 8 threads on the same quiet host, and the default thread count is revisited
The second lock is identified by measurement (suspect: the shared page-cache group mutex that SQLITE_ENABLE_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT forces) and a decision on it is recorded
